title: 10 ways to use ChatGPT to level up your small business – Futurpreneur

facts.fact: The Futurpreneur blog post '10 ways to use ChatGPT to level up your small business' was published on July 16, 2024.
Futurpreneur's article lists 10 tasks that ChatGPT can perform for small business owners.
facts.quote: Here are 10 tasks ChatGPT can perform for you so you can maximize your time

facts.fact: Futurpreneur states that ChatGPT is free to use.
facts.quote: ChatGPT is free and easy to use, once you get the hang of it

facts.fact: According to Futurpreneur, ChatGPT's maker OpenAI provides API access that lets businesses integrate ChatGPT into their social media platforms.
facts.quote: ChatGPT’s maker, OpenAI, provides API access that allows you to integrate ChatGPT into your social media platform.
